verdict.rationale: LobeChat provides detailed self-hosting docs including Docker Compose deployment, SSO provider configuration, integration with local models (Ollama, Azure OpenAI), and CLI/REST API access for operating an existing instance, confirming a genuinely self-hostable core product. Data is also stored locally client-side by default, reinforcing self-host/openness posture. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a self-hosted deployment working end-to-end, and clarity on which newer 'Agent/Task/Workspace' features are available in the self-hosted vs cloud SaaS version.
